assessment.decisionReason: Production deployment engineering exists, but the judge, independent assurance, organizational, and deployment-specific trust gates remain open.

frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework
CSA Cloud Controls Matrix and CAIQ
NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
CSA AI Consensus Assessments Initiative Questionnaire

controls.title: Technical security verification
gaps: The encoded tenant-isolation campaign is not a commissioned independent penetration test.

controls.title: Release integrity, SBOM, signing, and provenance
Transport, storage encryption, signing, and key management
gaps: Contracted TSA onboarding and certificate-pin approval are deployment-specific human gates.
AWS KMS is the only implemented production HSM provider; non-AWS customer-managed HSM portability remains open.

controls.title: Data protection, privacy, retention, and deletion
gaps: DPA, retention, deletion, litigation-hold, residency, and legal positions require counsel and customer-specific approval.

controls.title: Backup, recovery, failover, and resilience
gaps: Customer production topology must independently exercise and approve backup restore, region failover, RPO, and RTO.

controls.title: Incident and vulnerability response
gaps: Named 24x7 responders, customer notification, and a production incident exercise are organizational gates.

controls.title: Judge efficacy, policy integrity, and AI governance
gaps: Production requires and preloads the hash-verified ONNX transformers, but independent representative and adversarial efficacy approval for all three concerns is incomplete.

Version-pinned model cards and fail-closed drift-monitoring infrastructure exist; independently approved representative ONNX reference distributions and a completed drift alert/rollback exercise remain open.
Approved prevalence-adjusted operating points, OOD calibration, and production latency evidence remain open.

externalGates.title: Production judge and efficacy promotion
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Production transformer judges, independently approved model cards, adversarial and representative evaluation, calibrated operating points, version-pinned drift profiles plus alert/rollback exercise, and production latency evidence pass approved thresholds.

externalGates.title: Independent penetration test
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Signed report covers API, gateway, console, SDKs, PDP, tenant isolation, evidence chain, KMS, TSA, WORM, and deployment; critical and high findings are closed or CISO-accepted.

externalGates.title: KMS, TSA, and legal trust onboarding
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Approved production KMS keys and roles, independently obtained TSA pins, rotation evidence, and outside-counsel admissibility review are retained.

externalGates.title: Production operations and recovery acceptance
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Customer-topology deployment, backup restore, failover, RPO/RTO, alerts, SLOs, support, incident, escalation, and notification procedures are exercised and signed.

externalGates.title: Organizational, privacy, and procurement assurance
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Applicable SOC 2 or ISO evidence, SIG or CAIQ responses, DPA, privacy and residency terms, subprocessors, insurance, accessibility, support, and license terms are approved.

externalGates.title: Design-partner and production validation
externalGates.acceptanceCriteria: Approved pilot and production references demonstrate adoption, efficacy, operations, and support across the intended regulated-market boundary.
